def check(name, cond):
    print(("OK " if cond else "FAIL "), name)

for res, expected in [
    ("day", ["total_seconds", "days", "log1p_total_seconds"]),
    ("hour", ["total_seconds", "days", "hours", "log1p_total_seconds"]),
    ("minute", ["total_seconds", "days", "hours", "minutes", "log1p_total_seconds"]),
    ("second", ["total_seconds", "days", "hours", "minutes", "seconds", "log1p_total_seconds"]),
    ("microsecond", ["total_seconds", "days", "hours", "minutes", "seconds", "microseconds", "log1p_total_seconds"]),
]:
    for mod in ["pandas", "polars"]:
        if mod == "pandas":
            col = pd.Series([timedelta(days=1, hours=2, minutes=3, seconds=4, microseconds=5000)], name='d')
        else:
            col = pl.Series('d', [timedelta(days=1, hours=2, minutes=3, seconds=4, microseconds=5000)])
        enc = DurationEncoder(resolution=res)
        enc.fit_transform(col)
        check(f"{mod} resolution={res} components", enc.components_ == expected)

# auto whole days -> day
for mod in ["pandas", "polars"]:
    if mod == "pandas":
        col = pd.Series([timedelta(days=1), timedelta(days=3)], name='d')
    else:
        col = pl.Series('d', [timedelta(days=1), timedelta(days=3)])
    enc = DurationEncoder()
    enc.fit_transform(col)
    check(f"{mod} auto whole days -> day", enc.resolution_ == "day" and enc.components_ == ["total_seconds","days","log1p_total_seconds"])

# auto all null -> minute
for mod in ["pandas", "polars"]:
    if mod == "pandas":
        col = pd.Series([pd.NaT, pd.NaT], name='d')
    else:
        col = pl.Series('d', [None, None], dtype=pl.Duration("us"))
    enc = DurationEncoder()
    enc.fit_transform(col)
    check(f"{mod} auto all null -> minute", enc.resolution_ == "minute" and enc.components_ == ["total_seconds","days","hours","minutes","log1p_total_seconds"])

# explicit components with sin/cos
for mod in ["pandas", "polars"]:
    if mod == "pandas":
        col = pd.Series([timedelta(days=1)], name='d')
    else:
        col = pl.Series('d', [timedelta(days=1)])
    enc = DurationEncoder(components=["cos_of_day", "total_seconds", "sin_of_day"])
    out = enc.fit_transform(col)
    check(f"{mod} explicit sin/cos", enc.components_ == ["total_seconds", "sin_of_day", "cos_of_day"] and list(out.columns) == ['d_total_seconds','d_sin_of_day','d_cos_of_day'])

# validation
try:
    DurationEncoder(components=42)
    check("components int TypeError", False)
except TypeError:
    check("components int TypeError", True)
try:
    DurationEncoder(components=["bogus"])
    check("components bogus ValueError", False)
except ValueError:
    check("components bogus ValueError", True)
try:
    DurationEncoder(resolution="bogus").fit_transform(pd.Series([timedelta(days=1)], name='d'))
    check("resolution bogus ValueError", False)
except ValueError:
    check("resolution bogus ValueError", True)
try:
    DurationEncoder(handle_negative="bogus").fit_transform(pd.Series([timedelta(days=1)], name='d'))
    check("handle_negative bogus ValueError", False)
except ValueError:
    check("handle_negative bogus ValueError", True)
try:
    DurationEncoder(scaling="bogus").fit_transform(pd.Series([timedelta(days=1)], name='d'))
    check("scaling bogus ValueError", False)
except ValueError:
    check("scaling bogus ValueError", True)

# explicit list ignores resolution
enc = DurationEncoder(components=["days"], resolution="bogus")
enc.fit_transform(pd.Series([timedelta(days=1)], name='d'))
check("explicit ignores resolution", enc.components_ == ["days"] and enc.resolution_ is None)

# reject non-duration
for mod in ["pandas", "polars"]:

        check(f"{mod} reject non-duration", True)

# handle_negative
for mod in ["pandas", "polars"]:

    else:

    out = enc.fit_transform(col)
    check(f"{mod} null propagates", out.isna().all().all() if mod=='pandas' else out.null_count().to_series().sum() == 3)

        values = [

            None,
